title: What do parentheses change?
text: Parentheses are a grouping symbol: finish the inside before you use the result outside. A common mistake is to multiply $$2 \times 3$$ first and ignore the parentheses. What is $$8 + 2$$, the value inside the parentheses?

title: Use that result as a factor
text: The parentheses are now a single factor of 10. Multiplication is next. What is $$10 \times 3$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$(8 + 2) \times 3 = 10 \times 3 = 30$$. Common mistake: multiplying before adding inside the parentheses, which gives $$8 + 6 = 14$$. General rule: evaluate inside parentheses first, then use that number in the remaining expression.
